title: Light trapping and guided mode enhancement in perovskite/Si tandem solar cells with embedded silicon nanowires
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,49063-49073
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07413D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Arpan Saha, Mohammad Ajmain Fatin, Tasmiat Rahman, Mainul Hossain
Embedding Si nanowires between the perovskite and silicon subcells enables strong light-trapping and guided-mode coupling, boosting current generation and raising tandem efficiency from 26.98% to 32.11%.
